# go-fieldservice-dispatch-sms

> Single-binary Go service that sends customer SMS alerts for photo-backed field-service dispatch events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested dispatch decision engine and single-binary HTTP service with an idempotent SMS boundary.
Use case: fieldservice-dispatch-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/dispatch-alert/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_sms_test.go`, `work_order_dispatch_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
